Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1420
Claimant:
Pamela Church
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
02/17/2025
Claimant reported a left turn collision at an intersection and states the other vehicle struck the driver's side as the
claimant was completnig the turn. Claimant is not represented by counsel and has given a recorded statement.
02/20/2025
Police report was obtained and lists the claimant as the driver of the insured vehicle, with the other driver cited for
failing to yield. The driver is named on the policy and coverage is confirmed.
03/08/2025
Two independent witnesses at the scene were interviewed by phone and both describe the impact in the same
sequence as the claimant. Scene photos were received and show damage consistent with a side impact.
04/04/2025
Adjuster inspected the insured vehicle at the repair facility. The damage pattern lines up with the described impact,
and no prior unrelated damage was noted during the inspection.
04/13/2025
Claimant reports pain in the right shoulder and limited range of motion following the collision and was referred for an
initial medical evaluation. Medical records indicate the injury type and force of the crash are a good match.
05/16/2025
Claimant's medical history shows treatment for the same shoulder area within the last two years, and the treating
provider notes that this earlier conditoin contributes to some of the current complaints. Adjuster has noted this for the
injury evaluation.
06/21/2025
A neighbor contacted the office and said they believed the vehicle had been damaged a few weeks before the
reported loss. No photos or other support were provided, and the claim file has been flagged for follow-up with the
repair records.
06/29/2025
Treatment has followed a typical course of care, with frequency of visits tapering as the claimant improved. The
claimant has given the same account of events in every conversation with the adjuster and the medical team.
06/30/2025
Claimant is improving and is expected to return to normal activity shortly. Injury claim is under review pending the
prior-condition apportionment and the outcome of the follow-up on the neighbor's report.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
